Amumu.watch: If Amumu Q Bandage Toss hits, he can close in and stun you, so move with a jungle monster between you. Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy stuns nearby enemies, so spread out from allies while it is available. Amumu W Despair deals continuous damage up close, so avoid extended trades beside him.
Amumu.build: Amumu W Despair deals damage based on a percentage of maximum health, so build magic resistance alongside health rather than stacking health first. Magic resistance cannot reduce the true damage from Amumu P Cursed Touch, so do not expect resistance alone to absorb all his damage.
Amumu.fight: After Amumu Q Bandage Toss misses or Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is used, pick a target with Briar Q Head Rush and attack with Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. Recast W after the target loses health for damage and healing. If the trade becomes dangerous, use Briar E Chilling Scream to end the frenzy and regain control.
Amumu.laning: Early on, clear jungle camps with Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack and use Briar E Chilling Scream to heal at each camp. Look for ganks where an ally has reliable crowd control or the enemy has pushed up the lane.
Amumu.combo: After Amumu's crowd control has been spent, close in and stun him with Briar Q Head Rush, then activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. Use basic attacks to whittle down health, then recast W to bite and heal. If you can force Amumu toward a wall, fully charge Briar E Chilling Scream to stun him against it.
Amumu.escape: Look to engage when Amumu Q Bandage Toss misses or Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is used. Amumu has no ability to create distance on his own, so when you have an opening, close the gap with Briar Q Head Rush or Briar R Certain Death.
Amumu.phase: Late game, Briar can die before she heals if she engages first. Let allies start the fight, then move in to finish it.
Amumu.teamfight: While Amumu R Curse of the Sad Mummy is available, spread out from allies and fight in open space. If possible, commit after Amumu uses R. Once an ally lands the first crowd control, land Briar R Certain Death on an enemy your team can attack with you and engage. If the fight turns bad during Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, use Briar E Chilling Scream to end the frenzy.

Brand.watch: Brand P Blaze deals damage based on maximum health, and consecutive ability hits build stacks that explode. Focus on dodging his first ability. If you are ablaze, dodge the projectile from Brand Q Sear or take cover behind a minion. Spread out from allies when you see Brand R Pyroclasm being cast.
Brand.build: Build magic resistance first against Brand's damage. Because Brand P Blaze deals damage based on maximum health, avoid stacking only health. Also consider movement speed to leave telegraphed attack areas.
Brand.fight: Approach Brand after he uses Brand W Pillar of Flame. Pick him as your target and stun him with Briar Q Head Rush, then keep attacking with Briar W Blood Frenzy. Brand has relatively low armor, so Briar's primary physical damage hits him hard.
Brand.laning: Do not stand next to a minion Brand has set ablaze. If the wave is clustered, move to the side before approaching. While jungling, clear camps with Briar W Blood Frenzy and charge Briar E Chilling Scream to heal. Look for ganks when an ally has reliable crowd control or Brand has pushed up the lane.
Brand.combo: When targeting Brand, close in and stun him with Briar Q Head Rush, then activate Briar W Blood Frenzy and basic attack. Once Brand loses health, recast Briar W Snack Attack for damage and healing. If it becomes dangerous, use Briar E Chilling Scream to end the frenzy and regain control.
Brand.escape: Brand W Pillar of Flame being down is your chance to approach. If you are ablaze, dodge the stun from Brand Q Sear before going in. Brand has no mobility ability, so you can close the gap with Briar Q Head Rush.
Brand.phase: Briar has strong early ganks, but a failed engage is risky, so do not activate Briar W Blood Frenzy without an opening. Late game, let allies start the fight, then move in to finish it.
Brand.teamfight: Spread out before engaging to reduce the spread of Brand E Conflagration and the bounces of Brand R Pyroclasm. After an ally lands the first crowd control, use Briar R Certain Death on Brand from an angle where the front line will not block it and your team can attack him with you. If the fight turns bad after you engage, use Briar E Chilling Scream to end the frenzy.

Diana.watch: Diana Q Crescent Strike travels in an arc, so dodge sideways instead of only retreating. If it hits and marks you, move away because Diana E Lunar Rush can reset. Do not stay close while the orbs and shield from Diana W Pale Cascade remain. Spread out so Diana R Moonfall cannot pull in multiple allies.
Diana.build: Prioritize movement speed so you can walk out of telegraphed attack areas. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Diana's damage.
Diana.fight: Fight after the orbs from Diana W Pale Cascade disappear and its shield is gone. If you dodged Diana Q Crescent Strike and Diana E Lunar Rush is down, pick a target with Briar Q Head Rush and attack with Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. Recast W after the target loses health, or immediately if you urgently need healing.
Diana.laning: Do not activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack without an opening to engage.
Diana.combo: After Diana E Lunar Rush is used and the shield from Diana W Pale Cascade is gone, stun her with Briar Q Head Rush and activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. Lower her health with basic attacks, then recast W to bite. Use Briar E Chilling Scream to end the frenzy if needed.
Diana.escape: If Diana engages with Diana E Lunar Rush without a mark from Diana Q Crescent Strike, stun her with Briar Q Head Rush and stay close while her mobility is down. If Diana Q Crescent Strike marked you, keep your distance instead of chasing because Diana E Lunar Rush can reset. If the fight turns unfavorable during the frenzy, use Briar E Chilling Scream to regain control.
Diana.phase: Late game, let allies start the fight, then join in to finish it.
Diana.teamfight: Spread out so Diana R Moonfall cannot pull in multiple allies, and use vision to cover Diana's flank angles. After an ally lands the first crowd control, fire Briar R Certain Death at a target your team can attack with you. On landing, stun the target with Briar Q Head Rush and attack. If the fight turns bad, use Briar E Chilling Scream to end the frenzy.

Ekko.watch: When you see the indicator for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, leave the marked area to deny both its stun and shield. Step out of the return path of Ekko Q Timewinder. If Ekko R Chronobreak is available, do not overcommit to chasing him even when he is low on health.
Ekko.build: Prioritize magic resistance against Ekko's damage. If you cannot reliably avoid Ekko W Parallel Convergence with a mobility ability, prioritize tenacity over magic resistance. If the fight becomes a sustained exchange of healing because of Ekko R Chronobreak, fit Executioner's Calling between core items.
Ekko.fight: Right after Ekko closes in with Ekko E Phase Dive, look for a chance to stun him with Briar Q Head Rush. Avoid the area of Ekko W Parallel Convergence and commit to the fight after Ekko R Chronobreak is also used. Recast Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack after Ekko loses health, or immediately to heal if Briar urgently needs to survive.
Ekko.laning: While jungling, clear camps with Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack and heal with Briar E Chilling Scream. Gank a lane where Ekko has pushed up or an ally has reliable crowd control. Do not activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack without an opening.
Ekko.combo: After Ekko closes in with Ekko E Phase Dive, stun him with Briar Q Head Rush, then activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack and basic attack. Recast W once Ekko loses health. If the chase becomes dangerous, use Briar E Chilling Scream to end the frenzy and regain control.
Ekko.escape: Do not go too deep if only Ekko E Phase Dive is down, because he can escape with Ekko R Chronobreak. Commit when both Ekko W Parallel Convergence and Ekko R Chronobreak are down. Close the gap with Briar Q Head Rush or Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, then use Briar E Chilling Scream to stop his escape.
Ekko.phase: Briar has strong early ganks, but a failed engage can easily get her killed, so choose clear openings. Late game, let allies start the fight before going in.
Ekko.teamfight: After an ally lands the first crowd control, target an Ekko your team can attack with you using Briar R Certain Death. Right after Ekko closes in with Ekko E Phase Dive, look to stun him with Briar Q Head Rush to force Ekko R Chronobreak or stop his movement. If the fight turns bad during the frenzy, use Briar E Chilling Scream to end it.

Elise.watch: When health is full, watch for Elise Q Neurotoxin. After health has decreased, beware a finishing engage when Elise switches to Elise R Spider Form. Do not use Briar Q Head Rush while Elise E Rappel has her airborne; wait for her to land.
Elise.build: Build magic resistance first against Elise’s main ability damage, and consider armor for her basic attacks. If healing from Elise P Spider Queen prolongs fights, buy Executioner’s Calling between core items.
Elise.fight: After dodging or drawing out Elise E Cocoon, select your target with Briar Q Head Rush, then close in and attack with Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. Recast W after lowering her health for damage and healing, or use it immediately for healing if Briar’s health is in danger. If the fight turns against you during Frenzy, use Briar E Chilling Scream to end it and regain control.
Elise.laning: Elise builds leads through early ganks, so maintain ample vision and avoid pushing the lane too far when she is missing. Gank lanes where an ally has reliable crowd control or the enemy has pushed up. If there is no opening, do not activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack.
Elise.combo: Once Elise E Cocoon is down and you have seen her land, stun her with Briar Q Head Rush, then activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. Lower her health with basic attacks and recast W to bite. If she flees toward a wall, fully charge Briar E Chilling Scream to seek a wall stun.
Elise.escape: Right after Elise has finished using both Elise E Rappel and Elise E Cocoon is your window to turn and engage. Right after Elise uses Elise Q Neurotoxin / Venomous Bite, also close the gap with Briar Q Head Rush or Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, then block her escape route with Briar E Chilling Scream.
Elise.phase: Early on, watch for Elise’s ganks, avoid giving up kills, and buy time. Late game, Briar can fall before she heals if she engages first, so enter after an ally starts the fight.
Elise.teamfight: After an ally lands the first crowd control, aim the initial hit of Briar R Certain Death at Elise when your team can attack her with you. On landing, stun her with Briar Q Head Rush, attack, then recast Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. If the engage turns bad, use Briar E Chilling Scream to end Frenzy.

Evelynn.watch: When the mark from Evelynn W Allure appears, retreat before the charm triggers and alert your team. Evelynn R Last Caress deals more damage when health is low, and Evelynn cannot be targeted while casting it, so do not use Briar Q Head Rush at that moment.
Evelynn.build: Build magic resistance first against Evelynn’s main damage. Since Evelynn W Allure reduces magic resistance, prioritize retreating before its mark finishes charging. If healing from Evelynn P Demon Shade prolongs fights, buy Executioner’s Calling between core items.
Evelynn.fight: Retreat rather than fight while the mark from Evelynn W Allure charges. Once Evelynn R Last Caress is down, select her with Briar Q Head Rush and keep attacking with Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. Recast W after lowering her health for damage and healing. If the fight turns bad, use Briar E Chilling Scream to end Frenzy.
Evelynn.combo: When you have an opening to reach Evelynn, stun her first with Briar Q Head Rush, then activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. Lower her health with basic attacks, recast W, then follow with Briar E Chilling Scream. If her escape path leads toward a wall, fully charge E to seek a wall stun.
Evelynn.escape: Do not rush to chase just because Evelynn E Whiplash is down; she can still escape with Evelynn R Last Caress. Engage before her R comes back, but before the mark from Evelynn W Allure finishes charging and charms you. Close the gap with Briar Q Head Rush or Briar R Certain Death, then use Briar E Chilling Scream to block her escape.
Evelynn.phase: Late game, Briar can fall before she heals if she engages first, so enter after an ally starts the fight.
Evelynn.teamfight: Save Briar Q Head Rush while within your team’s vision in case Evelynn engages on a backline damage dealer. If you are positioned to catch Evelynn, stun her and attack with your team. When engaging with Briar R Certain Death, choose an angle clear of the frontline and a target your allies can attack immediately.
Evelynn.laning: Also place vision near your own jungle camps where Evelynn may start a fight, and have a Control Ward ready. Briar attacks the camp with Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, then heals with Briar E Chilling Scream when her health gets low.

Gragas.watch: When you see Gragas Q Barrel Roll, move outside its radius. If Gragas E Body Slam also hits you near the barrel, you can be knocked up and hit by Gragas R Explosive Cask. While his R is available, do not stand with the enemy turret or team behind you.
Gragas.build: If healing from Gragas P Happy Hour prolongs fights, buy Executioner’s Calling between core items. Build magic resistance over armor against his damage. Since Gragas tends to have high armor, add armor penetration for Briar’s physical damage.
Gragas.fight: Save your burst while Gragas drinks with Gragas W Drunken Rage, and attack after its damage reduction ends. Once Gragas E Body Slam is down, select him and close in with Briar Q Head Rush, then activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. Recast W after lowering Gragas’s health, or use it immediately for healing if Briar’s health is in danger.
Gragas.laning: In the jungle, clear camps with Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack and charge Briar E Chilling Scream to heal. Look for ganks when an ally has reliable crowd control or the enemy has pushed up. If Gragas E Body Slam is available and there is no gank opening, do not jump in first with W.
Gragas.combo: When Gragas E Body Slam is down, stun him with Briar Q Head Rush, then activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack and basic attack. After lowering his health, recast W to bite, then use Briar E Chilling Scream to end Frenzy or block his escape. If Gragas has his back to a wall, fully charge E to seek a wall stun.
Gragas.escape: Your opening to engage comes right after you make Gragas use Gragas E Body Slam. Close the gap with Briar Q Head Rush or Briar R Certain Death, then use Briar E Chilling Scream to block his escape. If you chase Gragas deep, he may use E again to get away, so chase only when you are sure you can take him down.
Gragas.phase: Early and mid game, watch for Gragas’s burst and ability to disrupt your formation; keep your formation in objective fights. Late game, his sustained damage weakens, but Briar can also fall before healing if she engages first, so follow an ally’s engage to finish the fight.
Gragas.teamfight: Keep your backline from standing alone within range of Gragas E Body Slam. If it lands, move outside the radius of Gragas Q Barrel Roll. After an ally lands the first crowd control, hit a target your team can attack with Briar R Certain Death. If the engage turns bad, use Briar E Chilling Scream to end Frenzy and regain control.

Fiddlesticks.watch: When you see Fiddlesticks channeling Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm, interrupt it with Briar Q Head Rush. If you can’t interrupt, move out of range and wait out its duration. If Fiddlesticks has been missing from vision for a while, watch out for bush ambushes and Terrify applied by a skill hit while he is unseen.
Fiddlesticks.build: If healing from Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest prolongs fights, buy Executioner’s Calling between core items. Build magic resistance over armor against his damage. Also consider movement speed to leave a telegraphed area so Fiddlesticks Q Terrify and the silence from Fiddlesticks E Reap do not hold you in his entire ultimate.
Fiddlesticks.fight: When Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest starts, interrupt its channel with the stun from a saved Briar Q Head Rush, then fight. Activating Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack before selecting a target can pull you toward an unwanted enemy, so close in with Q first. Recast W after lowering his health for damage and healing.
Fiddlesticks.laning: While clearing the jungle, use Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack on camps and charge Briar E Chilling Scream to heal when health has decreased. Gank lanes where an ally has reliable crowd control or the enemy has pushed up. Maintain vision in brush behind lanes against Fiddlesticks ambushes, and do not pass a stationary Scarecrow Effigy until you have checked it.
Fiddlesticks.combo: To engage Fiddlesticks, stun him with Briar Q Head Rush, then activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack and basic attack. Recast W once his health drops. If you need to save Q for the channel of Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest or Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm, interrupt that ability before engaging.
Fiddlesticks.escape: You can also engage after Fiddlesticks Q Terrify and Fiddlesticks E Reap are down, using Briar Q Head Rush to close the gap. If the engage becomes dangerous, use Briar E Chilling Scream to end Frenzy and regain control.
Fiddlesticks.phase: Early on, look for an opening to engage before Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm becomes available, but do not activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack if there is no gank opening. Late game, Briar can fall before healing if she enters first, so finish the fight after an ally starts it.
Fiddlesticks.teamfight: Secure vision in the brush and approach paths around objectives, and spread out so your team is not hit together by Fiddlesticks W Bountiful Harvest, Fiddlesticks E Reap, and Fiddlesticks R Crowstorm. If you see Fiddlesticks channeling R, you can interrupt it with Briar R Certain Death; if he has already arrived, leave its area. After an ally lands the first crowd control, engage on a target your team can attack, and use Briar E Chilling Scream to end Frenzy if the fight turns bad.

Graves.watch: Graves Q End of the Line detonates immediately when it hits terrain, so avoid fighting with your back to a wall or in narrow jungle paths. If Graves W Smoke Screen catches you, take the shortest route out of its area, then reengage. Graves P New Destiny's basic attacks stop at the first unit hit, so keep an ally or minion between you and him.
Graves.build: Graves deals primarily physical damage, so build armor first. Buy Plated Steelcaps early for fights in the early and mid game.
Graves.fight: Counterattack or create distance when Graves has fired both shots and is reloading. Once you have chosen a target to engage, stun Graves with Briar Q Head Rush, then activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. If you are inside Graves W Smoke Screen, leave its area before reengaging.
Graves.laning: Graves becomes harder to fight as time passes because the strength he builds with Graves E Quickdraw persists, so pressure him from the start. Choose ganks where your ally has reliable crowd control or the opponent has pushed the lane. If there’s no opening, don’t activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack.
Graves.combo: Stun Graves with Briar Q Head Rush, then enter frenzy with Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack and basic attack him. Once Graves has lost health, recast Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack to bite him. Use Briar E Chilling Scream when you need to end frenzy or survive.
Graves.escape: Do not engage immediately just because Graves E Quickdraw is down. Look for a window before Graves R Collateral Damage is ready again, then close the gap with Briar Q Head Rush or Briar R Certain Death. If Graves W Smoke Screen catches you, leave its area before reengaging.
Graves.phase: Pressure Graves early so he has no time to build stacks. Late game, wait for your allies to start the fight, then follow up to finish it.
Graves.teamfight: After an ally lands the first crowd control, aim Briar R Certain Death at Graves when your allies can attack him with you. After landing, stun him with Briar Q Head Rush and attack with Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. If the engage becomes dangerous, use Briar E Chilling Scream to end frenzy and regain control.

Hecarim.watch: Hecarim E Devastating Charge deals more damage and knocks back farther the farther he runs, so move toward your allies when he turns and starts charging. While Hecarim W Spirit of Dread is active, even damage from your allies heals him, so do not stay in a prolonged fight at close range. Spread out in teamfights so Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows cannot fear several of you at once.
Hecarim.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Hecarim Q Rampage and Hecarim E Devastating Charge.
Hecarim.fight: When a fight starts, hinder Hecarim's movement with the stun from Briar Q Head Rush or the slow from Briar E Chilling Scream. Recast Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack after Hecarim has lost health, but use it immediately for healing if Briar is in danger.
Hecarim.laning: Gank lanes where an ally has reliable crowd control or the enemy has pushed up. If there is no opening, do not activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack.
Hecarim.combo: When targeting Hecarim, use Briar Q Head Rush to lock onto and stun him, then activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack and basic attack. Once Hecarim has lost health, recast Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack for an empowered attack and healing. If you engage a teamfight with Briar R Certain Death, follow up after landing with Briar Q Head Rush, basic attacks, a Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack recast, then Briar E Chilling Scream.
Hecarim.escape: Do not engage immediately just because Hecarim E Devastating Charge is down. Look for a window before Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows is ready again. Close the gap with Briar Q Head Rush or Briar R Certain Death, and hinder his movement with Briar E Chilling Scream. If the engage goes badly, use Briar E Chilling Scream to end frenzy and regain control.
Hecarim.phase: Late game, wait for your allies to start the fight, then follow up to finish it.
Hecarim.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so Hecarim R Onslaught of Shadows cannot hit several of you. After an ally lands the first crowd control, aim Briar R Certain Death at Hecarim when your allies can attack him with you. After landing, follow up with the stun from Briar Q Head Rush. If the fight turns against you, use Briar E Chilling Scream to end frenzy.

Ivern.watch: If Ivern Q Rootcaller roots you, Ivern's allies can dash into range, so keep minions or terrain between you and him to avoid his firing angle. If Ivern R Daisy! starts attacking you, reposition to prevent the knockup from three consecutive attacks. Do not walk carelessly past brush that suddenly appears from Ivern W Brushmaker.
Ivern.build: The main danger is your allies joining the fight after the root from Ivern Q Rootcaller or the knockup from Ivern R Daisy!, so consider tenacity first. Consider Mercurial Scimitar if a long root prevents you from basic attacking and cuts off your healing. If you build resistance against Ivern's ability damage, choose magic resistance over armor.
Ivern.fight: Do not engage a target already affected by Ivern E Triggerseed. After the shield bursts, use Briar Q Head Rush to lock onto the target and close in. Then keep basic attacking with Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, and recast it after the enemy has lost health for damage and healing. If the fight goes badly, use Briar E Chilling Scream to end frenzy and regain control.
Ivern.laning: Gank lanes where an ally has reliable crowd control or the enemy has pushed up. Briar has no base health regeneration, so keep using Briar E Chilling Scream to heal at each camp.
Ivern.combo: When ganking, stun your target with Briar Q Head Rush, then activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack and basic attack. Recast Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack once the enemy has lost health, and use Briar E Chilling Scream to end frenzy when needed. In teamfights, after an ally lands the first crowd control, land Briar R Certain Death to inflict fear, then follow up with Briar Q Head Rush.
Ivern.escape: Ivern Q Rootcaller is both Ivern's way to close the gap and his root, so the moment after you make him use it is your chance to close in. Use Briar Q Head Rush or Briar R Certain Death to lock onto a target and engage, then keep attacking with Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. If the target has Ivern E Triggerseed before you engage, wait for the shield to burst.
Ivern.phase: Late game, Briar can fall before she heals if she engages first. Follow up on a fight your allies start and finish it.
Ivern.teamfight: After an ally lands the first crowd control, aim Briar R Certain Death at a target your allies can attack with you. If Ivern R Daisy! is in front, avoid an angle that sends the ability into Daisy instead of the enemy behind her. Reposition if Daisy attacks you repeatedly. If the fight turns against you during frenzy, use Briar E Chilling Scream to regain control.

Karthus.watch: Karthus Q Lay Waste deals more damage when it hits you alone, so watch for its blast indicator and walk out of it. Karthus W Wall of Pain reduces magic resistance and slows you, so go around the wall. After killing Karthus, immediately move away from his body to avoid Karthus Q Lay Waste and Karthus E Defile cast during Karthus P Death Defied.
Karthus.build: All of Karthus's damage is magic, so build magic resistance before armor. Get movement speed as well to avoid Karthus W Wall of Pain and leave the area of Karthus E Defile quickly.
Karthus.fight: Karthus has no ability to create distance, so approach along a path that avoids Karthus W Wall of Pain and lock onto him with Briar Q Head Rush. Once close, attack with Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, then recast it after he has lost health for damage and healing.
Karthus.laning: If there is no opening, do not activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. Keep enough health after a fight to survive Karthus R Requiem.
Karthus.combo: Stun Karthus with Briar Q Head Rush and activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. Lower his health with basic attacks, then recast it to bite him. Use Briar E Chilling Scream when you need to end frenzy. If Karthus has his back to a wall, fully charge it to try to stun him against the wall.
Karthus.escape: If Karthus W Wall of Pain has been placed, approach from around it instead of chasing through it.
Karthus.phase: Early game, disrupt the growth of Karthus, who has no mobility ability, by invading his jungle or ganking.
Karthus.teamfight: Clear the frontline before Karthus gets within range of Karthus E Defile. After an ally lands the first crowd control, engage with Briar R Certain Death toward a target your allies can attack with you. Even if you kill Karthus, do not stay near his body. If the engage goes badly, use Briar E Chilling Scream to end frenzy and get out.

Jax.watch: While Jax E Counter Strike is active, he dodges basic attacks, and its recast damage increases with each attack dodged. Move outside the stun range and wait for it to end. If Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack prevents you from retreating, use Briar E Chilling Scream to end the frenzy.
Jax.build: Jax relies on basic attacks and attack speed for damage, so prioritize considering attack speed reduction. Jax Q Leap Strike deals physical damage, while Jax W Empower and Jax E Counter Strike deal magic damage, so do not build only one type of resistance. Jax E Counter Strike also deals damage based on maximum health, so be cautious about stacking health alone.
Jax.fight: Start trading after Jax E Counter Strike is down. If he has just used Jax Q Leap Strike too, close in and stun him with Briar Q Head Rush, then activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack once you have selected your target. If Jax E Counter Strike is activated again, stop basic attacking. If you are frenzied, use Briar E Chilling Scream to regain control.
Jax.laning: Jax has the advantage in a level 1 melee fight, so do not force a fight when you have only one ability. When ganking as Briar, choose a lane where an ally has guaranteed crowd control or Jax has pushed the wave. If there is no opening, do not activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack.
Jax.combo: Once Jax E Counter Strike has ended and Jax Q Leap Strike is down, close in and stun him with Briar Q Head Rush. Then activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack and basic attack. Recast it after Jax has lost health to bite him and heal. If Jax E Counter Strike activates or the engage becomes dangerous, use Briar E Chilling Scream to end the frenzy.
Jax.escape: Right after Jax uses Jax Q Leap Strike is your window to close the distance. Once the stun from Jax E Counter Strike has also ended, engage with Briar Q Head Rush or Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, then look for a slow or stun with Briar E Chilling Scream. Wait to engage while Jax E Counter Strike is active.
Jax.teamfight: If Jax jumps in with Jax E Counter Strike active, do not group closely; wait for the area stun to end. Then follow an ally's first crowd control with Briar Q Head Rush to lock down Jax, or use Briar R Certain Death on a target your allies can immediately attack with you. If the fight turns bad after you enter with Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, use Briar E Chilling Scream to end the frenzy.

Kayn.watch: Dodge the straight-line hit from Kayn W Blade's Reach to prevent Kayn from following it with a long-range engage using Kayn R Umbral Trespass. If a warning appears at the edge of a wall, Kayn is approaching with Kayn E Shadow Step; stop fighting and retreat.
Kayn.build: Build armor first against the main damage from Kayn Q Reaping Slash, Kayn W Blade's Reach, and Kayn R Umbral Trespass. If Kayn transforms into the Darkin and sustains through healing, buy Executioner's Calling between core items.
Kayn.fight: Dodge Kayn W Blade's Reach and look for a fight before Kayn R Umbral Trespass is available again. If Kayn enters a wall with Kayn E Shadow Step, interrupt him with the stun from Briar Q Head Rush, then activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack after choosing your target.
Kayn.laning: Kayn is weak before transforming, so pressure his early jungle path and force objectives to delay his transformation. Use Briar E Chilling Scream to heal at each camp, and gank lanes where an ally has guaranteed crowd control or the opponent has pushed the wave. If a Kayn E Shadow Step warning appears at the edge of a wall, stop fighting and retreat toward your turret.
Kayn.combo: After dodging Kayn W Blade's Reach, stun your target with Briar Q Head Rush, then activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack and basic attack. Recast Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack after the target has lost health. If you have driven them toward a wall, fully charge Briar E Chilling Scream to follow up with a wall stun.
Kayn.escape: Do not rush the engage just because Kayn Q Reaping Slash is down; Kayn can escape with Kayn R Umbral Trespass. Before Kayn R Umbral Trespass is available again, if you have also dodged Kayn W Blade's Reach, close the distance with Briar Q Head Rush, Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, and Briar R Certain Death.
Kayn.phase: Kayn is weak early before transforming, so pressure him, but choose your engage carefully to avoid giving him a kill and speeding up his transformation. Late game, engaging first can get you killed before you can heal, so finish fights after your allies start them.
Kayn.teamfight: After an ally lands the first crowd control, use Briar R Certain Death on a target your team can attack together. An ally caught in Kayn R Umbral Trespass cannot help during that time, so prepare to stun Kayn with Briar Q Head Rush as he emerges near the target. If the fight turns bad during Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, use Briar E Chilling Scream to end the frenzy and regain control.

JarvanIV.fight: If Briar's health is dangerously low, recast to heal instead of waiting to finish the target.
JarvanIV.laning: Gank lanes where an ally has guaranteed crowd control or the opponent has pushed the wave. At jungle camps, clear with Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack and charge Briar E Chilling Scream to heal when health has decreased.
JarvanIV.combo: Lower the target's health with basic attacks, then recast Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack for damage based on their missing health and for healing. If the fight turns bad, use Briar E Chilling Scream to end the frenzy and regain control.
JarvanIV.teamfight: After an ally lands the first crowd control, engage by hitting an opponent your team can attack together with Briar R Certain Death. After landing, stun them with Briar Q Head Rush, then finish with basic attacks and the recast of Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. If the fight turns bad during the frenzy, use Briar E Chilling Scream to regain control.

Khazix.watch: Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear deals heavy damage to isolated targets, so stay near your allies. If Kha'Zix disappears with Kha'Zix R Void Assault, do not chase to find him; stun him with Briar Q Head Rush when he reappears. Once Kha'Zix E Leap is evolved, he can use it again after a takedown, so avoid chasing immediately after an ally is picked off.
Khazix.build: Build armor first against Kha'Zix's main damage. If healing from Kha'Zix W Void Spike prolongs fights, fit Executioner's Calling between core items.
Khazix.fight: Stay close to allies to avoid isolation, and counterattack right after Kha'Zix uses Kha'Zix E Leap. Lock onto your target with Briar Q Head Rush, then activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack and attack. Recast Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack after the target has lost health, but use it immediately for healing if Briar urgently needs to survive.
Khazix.laning: While jungling, avoid letting Kha'Zix track you when you are alone, and prioritize vision in the river and in brush at jungle entrances. Clear camps with Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack and charge Briar E Chilling Scream to heal. Gank lanes where an ally has guaranteed crowd control or the opponent has pushed the wave.
Khazix.combo: When Kha'Zix E Leap is down, close in and stun him with Briar Q Head Rush, then activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. Lower his health with basic attacks and recast Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack to bite him. Then use Briar E Chilling Scream to end the frenzy or block his escape route.
Khazix.escape: Right after Kha'Zix uses Kha'Zix E Leap to engage is Briar's window to go in. If he becomes invisible with Kha'Zix R Void Assault, do not chase blindly. Stay near your allies and close in with Briar Q Head Rush the moment he reappears.
Khazix.phase: Late game, Briar should join and finish fights her allies have started instead of engaging first.
Khazix.teamfight: Group with allies in a narrow area where you have vision to avoid the isolation damage from Kha'Zix Q Taste Their Fear. After an ally lands the first crowd control, target someone your team can attack together with Briar R Certain Death, then stun them with Briar Q Head Rush after landing. If the fight turns bad during Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, use Briar E Chilling Scream to end the frenzy and regain control.

Kindred.watch: If you are marked, create distance or break vision to avoid further attacks. Kindred frequently uses Kindred Q Dance of Arrows to roll away inside Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy, so do not chase her there for long.
Kindred.build: If healing prolongs the duel, buy Executioner's Calling between core items to counter the healing from Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy and Kindred R Lamb's Respite.
Kindred.fight: Before Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy comes back up, use Briar Q Head Rush to lock onto her, then activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. Look for a chance to push her out of Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy with Briar E Chilling Scream instead of continuing to chase inside it. Recast Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack after the opponent has lost health, or immediately if you need healing.
Kindred.laning: When Kindred P Mark of the Kindred appears on a jungle monster, take the camp first or ward nearby to delay her claim. Ward the enemy jungle to disrupt her pathing, and choose ganks where an ally has reliable crowd control or the enemy has pushed the lane. Briar has no base health regeneration, so use Briar E Chilling Scream to heal at each camp.
Kindred.combo: Stun Kindred with Briar Q Head Rush, activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, and basic attack her. Once her health drops, recast Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, then use Briar E Chilling Scream to hinder her movement or end the frenzy. If you can push her toward a wall, fully charge Briar E Chilling Scream for the wall stun.
Kindred.escape: Do not rush in just because Kindred Q Dance of Arrows is down; she can still escape with Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy. Close the gap with Briar Q Head Rush or Briar R Certain Death before Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy comes back up, especially before she places its zone. If the fight turns bad after you engage, use Briar E Chilling Scream to end the frenzy and regain control.
Kindred.phase: Kindred is vulnerable to early pressure, so use vision to disrupt her pathing and delay her Kindred P Mark of the Kindred stacks. Later, Briar can die before she heals if she goes in first, so enter after your allies engage and finish the fight.
Kindred.teamfight: After an ally lands the first crowd control, aim Briar R Certain Death at Kindred when your allies can attack her with you. She can keep rolling away inside Kindred W Wolf's Frenzy, so look for a chance to push her out with Briar E Chilling Scream. When Kindred R Lamb's Respite activates, stay alive inside its zone with low-health allies and prepare for the fight after it ends.

LeeSin.watch: Lee Sin can cross a wall from outside your vision with Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will, so stand away from walls. Keep space between yourself and allies so you do not overlap when Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage kicks you.
LeeSin.build: Build armor first against Lee Sin's main damage from Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike and Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage. Armor cannot block the magic damage from Lee Sin E Tempest / Cripple. If his basic attacks are a problem, also consider reducing his attack speed.
LeeSin.fight: Avoid dueling Lee Sin if you meet him in the jungle early. When Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike misses or is still on cooldown, use Briar Q Head Rush to lock onto him, then activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. Recast Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack after the opponent has lost health, or recast early to heal if you are in danger.
LeeSin.laning: In a lane where you expect a gank, keep minions between you and Lee Sin to block a straight Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike. As Briar, choose ganks where an ally has reliable crowd control or the enemy has pushed the lane. Clear jungle camps with Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack and use Briar E Chilling Scream to heal.
LeeSin.combo: When closing on Lee Sin, stun him and lock onto him with Briar Q Head Rush, then activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack and basic attack. Recast Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack after the opponent has lost health, and use Briar E Chilling Scream to block his escape or end the frenzy.
LeeSin.escape: Before Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike comes back up is your opening. If only Lee Sin W Safeguard / Iron Will is down, he still has other mobility available, so confirm that Lee Sin Q Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike is down too before closing the gap with Briar Q Head Rush, Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, and Briar R Certain Death. If the fight turns bad, use Briar E Chilling Scream to end the frenzy and retreat.
LeeSin.phase: Lee Sin is strong in early duels, so back off if you meet him in the jungle. He falls off later, but Briar can still die before healing if she engages first. Enter after your allies start the fight.
LeeSin.teamfight: After an ally lands the first crowd control, hit a target your allies can attack with Briar R Certain Death. Watch for Lee Sin R Dragon's Rage: limit the space he has to get behind you, and keep enough distance from allies that you do not collide with them. If the fight turns bad after you engage, use Briar E Chilling Scream to end the frenzy.

Lillia.watch: Avoid Lillia Q Blooming Blows and Lillia E Swirlseed even at high health, since either can set you up to be slept by Lillia R Lilting Lullaby. If Lillia R Lilting Lullaby hits you, move to safety during the drowsy period before you fall asleep. When you see Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! wind up, move sideways to avoid its center.
Lillia.build: Buy Executioner's Calling between core items to counter the healing from Lillia P Dream-Laden Bough. Build magic resistance first against her main damage, and consider armor to withstand her basic attacks. Avoid stacking only health because Lillia Q Blooming Blows deals true damage and Lillia P Dream-Laden Bough deals damage based on maximum health.
Lillia.fight: Dodge Lillia's abilities so she cannot build movement speed stacks, then close the gap. Right after she uses Lillia W Watch Out! Eep!, get close and stun her with Briar Q Head Rush, lock onto her, then attack with Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. Lillia's low armor makes her vulnerable to Briar's physical damage, but be careful about using abilities in quick succession when your health is low.
Lillia.laning: Clear camps with Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, and get into a rhythm of charging Briar E Chilling Scream at each camp to heal. Choose ganks where an ally has reliable crowd control or the enemy has pushed the lane. When you do not know Lillia's location, avoid walking straight through narrow jungle entrances or river paths where Lillia E Swirlseed is hard to dodge.
Lillia.combo: When ganking Lillia, stun and lock onto her with Briar Q Head Rush, then activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack and basic attack. Recast Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack to bite her after lowering her health, and use Briar E Chilling Scream to end the frenzy or hold her in place. Use Briar Q Head Rush first, because activating Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack first prevents you from choosing your target.
Lillia.escape: Right after drawing out Lillia W Watch Out! Eep! is your window to close the gap with Briar Q Head Rush or Briar R Certain Death. Dodge Lillia Q Blooming Blows and Lillia E Swirlseed so she cannot gain movement speed stacks or meet the condition for Lillia R Lilting Lullaby before you go in. If the fight turns bad after you engage, use Briar E Chilling Scream to end the frenzy and regain control.
Lillia.phase: Briar's early ganks are strong, but a failed engage can easily get her killed, so take only clear opportunities. Later, she can die before healing if she goes in first, so finish the fight after your allies engage.
Lillia.teamfight: Save immobilizing crowd control such as Briar Q Head Rush to catch Lillia when she comes in from the side. After an ally lands the first crowd control, fire Briar R Certain Death from an angle where the frontline cannot block it, at a target your allies can attack with you. After landing, stun with Briar Q Head Rush and attack, then recast Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. If the fight turns bad, use Briar E Chilling Scream to end the frenzy.

Nidalee.watch: Nidalee Q Javelin Toss hurts more the farther it travels, so always dodge spears thrown from long range. Nidalee W Bushwhack also applies the Hunted mark, so be careful at jungle entrances and along the river. If you are marked, save Briar Q Head Rush or Briar E Chilling Scream for when she comes in with Nidalee W Pounce.
Nidalee.build: If Nidalee is sustaining through the fight with Nidalee E Primal Surge, buy Executioner's Calling between core items. Build magic resistance against her main damage. Even with resistance, dodge long-range Nidalee Q Javelin Toss first.
Nidalee.fight: Dodge Nidalee Q Javelin Toss and Nidalee W Bushwhack to start the fight without a Hunted mark. Right after she uses Nidalee W Pounce, get close and stun her with Briar Q Head Rush, lock onto her, then activate Briar W Blood Frenzy. Once her health drops, use Briar W Snack Attack to deal damage and heal.
Nidalee.laning: Clear jungle camps with Briar W Blood Frenzy and heal with Briar E Chilling Scream. When entering the river or a jungle entrance, check for Nidalee W Bushwhack with a Control Ward or an area ability. Choose ganks where an ally has reliable crowd control or the enemy has pushed the lane, and do not activate Briar W Blood Frenzy if there is no opening.
Nidalee.combo: After Nidalee W Pounce is down, close in and stun her with Briar Q Head Rush, then activate Briar W Blood Frenzy. Lower her health with basic attacks before recasting Briar W Snack Attack. If Nidalee flees toward a wall, fully charge Briar E Chilling Scream for the wall stun.
Nidalee.escape: Right after drawing out Nidalee W Pounce is your chance to close the gap with Briar Q Head Rush or Briar R Certain Death. Nidalee has no crowd control, so close in while Nidalee W Pounce is down and use Briar E Chilling Scream to block her escape. If the fight turns against you after engaging with Briar W Blood Frenzy, use Briar E Chilling Scream to end the frenzy and retreat.
Nidalee.phase: Early on, a failed Briar engage can get her killed, so take only clear gank opportunities. Later, wait for your allies to start the fight, then catch Nidalee and finish her.
Nidalee.teamfight: Remember where Nidalee stood to throw Nidalee Q Javelin Toss, and go in after an ally lands the first crowd control. Fire Briar R Certain Death at Nidalee when your allies can immediately attack her with you. After landing, stun her with Briar Q Head Rush and attack with Briar W Blood Frenzy. If the fight turns bad, use Briar E Chilling Scream to end the frenzy.

MonkeyKing.watch: Wukong E Nimbus Strike is targeted, so you cannot dodge it; manage your distance outside its range. If Wukong E Nimbus Strike closes the gap and Wukong Q Crushing Blow hits you, the armor reduction puts you at a disadvantage in the trade. The clone left by Wukong W Warrior Trickster stays in place, so check which way the real Wukong is escaping before using Briar Q Head Rush on it.
MonkeyKing.build: Build armor first against Wukong's main damage. Wukong E Nimbus Strike deals magic damage, and Wukong Q Crushing Blow reduces armor, so do not build only armor and then keep fighting while taking hits. If healing from Wukong P Stone Skin makes duels drag on, buy Executioner's Calling between core items to maintain Grievous Wounds.
MonkeyKing.fight: Avoid long duels that let Wukong P Stone Skin stack. Deal damage briefly, then back off. After Wukong W Warrior Trickster is used, stun the real Wukong with Briar Q Head Rush and deal damage with Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. If Blood Frenzy makes the chase dangerous, end it with Briar E Chilling Scream and retreat.
MonkeyKing.laning: During early jungle clears, use Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack to clear camps and charge Briar E Chilling Scream to heal when your health drops. Choose ganks where an ally has reliable crowd control or the enemy has pushed the lane. If Wukong can still use both Wukong W Warrior Trickster and Wukong E Nimbus Strike, do not activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack just because one of them has been used.
MonkeyKing.combo: After checking which way the real Wukong escapes with Wukong W Warrior Trickster, use Briar Q Head Rush to lock onto and stun him. Then activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack for basic attacks, and recast it after Wukong loses health to bite and heal. If Wukong has his back to a wall, fully charge Briar E Chilling Scream to try to stun him against it. If you need to stop chasing, use Briar E Chilling Scream to end Blood Frenzy.
MonkeyKing.escape: The window to engage is after Wukong W Warrior Trickster has been used and before it returns. If Wukong E Nimbus Strike has also been used, close the gap with Briar Q Head Rush, Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, or Briar R Certain Death. Once you reach him, use Briar E Chilling Scream to block his escape route.
MonkeyKing.phase: Early Briar has strong kill involvement on ganks, but a failed engage can easily get her killed, so choose your opening carefully. Later, engaging first can get you killed before you heal; go in to finish the fight after your allies start it.
MonkeyKing.teamfight: When Wukong R Cyclone is available, keep your distance from allies to avoid its area knockup. Immediately after Wukong R Cyclone has been fully spent, look for a chance to force an objective or fight. After an ally lands the first crowd control, use Briar R Certain Death on a target your allies can attack with you. Stun the target with Briar Q Head Rush after landing and finish with Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. If the situation worsens, end Blood Frenzy with Briar E Chilling Scream.

MasterYi.watch: Master Yi cannot be targeted during Master Yi Q Alpha Strike, so use Briar Q Head Rush immediately after he reappears. Slows do not work while Master Yi R Highlander is active, so do not rely on the slow from Briar E Chilling Scream alone to create distance. Watch out for basic attacks empowered by Master Yi E Wuju Style, which include true damage.
MasterYi.build: Armor cannot prevent the true damage from Master Yi E Wuju Style, so build health too. If the fight becomes a contest of sustained healing, buy Executioner's Calling between core items and consider a way to reduce attack speed.
MasterYi.fight: Immediately after Master Yi Q Alpha Strike ends, close in and stun him with Briar Q Head Rush, then activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. After basic attacks lower his health, recast Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack for damage based on missing health and healing. If it becomes dangerous, recast sooner or end Blood Frenzy with Briar E Chilling Scream to regain control.
MasterYi.laning: Early on, take early objectives to slow the growth of Master Yi, whose ganks are weak. Choose ganks where an ally has reliable crowd control or the enemy has pushed the lane. In jungle camps, clear with Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack and manage your health by using Briar E Chilling Scream to heal.
MasterYi.combo: When Master Yi Q Alpha Strike ends, use Briar Q Head Rush to lock onto and stun him, then activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. Lower his health with basic attacks and recast Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack to bite. Use Briar E Chilling Scream to end Blood Frenzy or stun him if he is driven toward a wall. If you need to interrupt Master Yi W Meditate, save the stun from Briar Q Head Rush.
MasterYi.escape: Master Yi Q Alpha Strike is his only mobility tool, so the moment it ends is your window to engage. Close in and stun him with Briar Q Head Rush, then keep attacking with Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. If Master Yi R Highlander is active, hold him with a stun instead of a slow.
MasterYi.phase: Early Master Yi is weak in jungle skirmishes and ganks, so gain an advantage through fights when you encounter him and through early objectives. Master Yi grows stronger as the game goes on, while engaging first becomes dangerous for Briar later. Go in to finish the fight after your allies start it.
MasterYi.teamfight: Coordinate overlapping crowd control with your team to kill Master Yi during the first engage and deny him his first takedown. After Master Yi Q Alpha Strike ends, land Briar Q Head Rush's stun. If Master Yi uses W Meditate, interrupt it with the immobilizing crowd control you held back. Aim Briar R Certain Death at a target your team can attack immediately, and if the engage becomes dangerous, use Briar E Chilling Scream to end Blood Frenzy.

Nunu.watch: Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! rolls in from a long distance and knocks you up. When you see it, do not just run backward; move toward the side the snowball came from and escape through the ground Nunu & Willump has already passed. If Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage hits you, leave the area immediately before the root follows, and do not stay within Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero.
Nunu.build: Buy Executioner's Calling early between core items to counter the healing from Nunu & Willump Q Consume. Build magic resistance against Nunu & Willump's main damage and tenacity against the snowball's crowd control. If the root from Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage keeps interrupting the time you have to attack up close, consider Mercurial Scimitar.
Nunu.fight: Nunu & Willump has no ability to create distance on its own, so when you have an opening to close in, lock onto the target with Briar Q Head Rush and activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. Lower its health with basic attacks and bleed, then recast Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack for damage based on missing health and healing. Recast sooner if it becomes dangerous, and use Briar E Chilling Scream when you need to end Blood Frenzy.
Nunu.laning: Nunu & Willump can roll a Scuttle Crab in and return after a gank, so watch for a second entry. Briar clears camps with Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack and can charge Briar E Chilling Scream to heal when her health drops.
Nunu.combo: To catch Nunu & Willump up close, stun with Briar Q Head Rush, enter Blood Frenzy with Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, and land basic attacks before recasting once its health has dropped. If you need to interrupt the channel of Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero, hit with the bloodstone from Briar R Certain Death. To finish it off when its escape route leads toward a wall, fully charge Briar E Chilling Scream to try for a wall stun.
Nunu.escape: Your chance to close in comes after dodging the knockup from Nunu & Willump W Biggest Snowball Ever! and escaping the root from Nunu & Willump E Snowball Barrage. Nunu & Willump has no ability to create distance on its own, so use Briar Q Head Rush to close in and lock onto it, then activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. If the engage becomes dangerous during Blood Frenzy, end it with Briar E Chilling Scream and retreat.
Nunu.phase: Later, engaging first can get Briar killed before she heals, so go in after your allies start the fight.
Nunu.teamfight: When Nunu & Willump R Absolute Zero begins, the bloodstone from Briar R Certain Death can interrupt its channel. Wait for an ally's first crowd control before engaging, and aim Briar R Certain Death at a target your allies can attack with you. If the situation worsens after you enter Blood Frenzy, use Briar E Chilling Scream to regain control.

Poppy.fight: After Poppy W Steadfast Presence ends and immediately after she uses Poppy E Heroic Charge, use Briar Q Head Rush to lock onto her and close in. Activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack once you reach her, then recast it after her health drops for damage and healing. Poppy gains armor when her health is low, so check that you have enough damage to finish her before committing.
Poppy.laning: In the jungle, clear camps with Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack and use Briar E Chilling Scream to heal. Choose ganks when an ally has reliable crowd control or Poppy has pushed the lane. Approach through open ground to avoid a wall stun from Poppy E Heroic Charge, and do not activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack if there is no opening.
Poppy.combo: After Poppy W Steadfast Presence ends and she uses Poppy E Heroic Charge, stun her with Briar Q Head Rush and activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. Lower her health with basic attacks, then recast Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack to bite. End Blood Frenzy with Briar E Chilling Scream if needed. If Poppy retreats toward a wall, fully charge Briar E Chilling Scream to try for a wall stun.
Poppy.escape: Immediately after Poppy uses Poppy E Heroic Charge is Briar's chance to close the gap. Confirm that Poppy W Steadfast Presence has also ended, then engage with Briar Q Head Rush or Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. If the situation worsens after engaging, end Blood Frenzy with Briar E Chilling Scream to regain control.
Poppy.phase: Early on, Briar's engage is dangerous while Poppy W Steadfast Presence and Poppy E Heroic Charge are available, so choose your gank openings carefully. Later, engaging first can get you killed before you heal, so finish the fight after your allies start it.
Poppy.build: Build armor first against Poppy’s main damage from Poppy Q Hammer Shock, Poppy E Heroic Charge, and Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict. Poppy Q Hammer Shock deals damage based on your maximum health, so be cautious about choosing items that add a lot of health alone. Don’t spend resources specifically on magic resistance to fight Poppy alone.
Poppy.teamfight: After an ally lands the first crowd control, use Briar R Certain Death on a target your allies can attack with you. Wait to dash while Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, and move sideways when facing Poppy as she charges Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict. If chasing with Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack becomes dangerous, use Briar E Chilling Scream to end the frenzy.
Poppy.watch: While Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, it blocks the dashes from Briar Q Head Rush and Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, so wait until it ends. If Poppy E Heroic Charge knocks you into a wall, you are stunned. Poppy Q Hammer Shock deals its second hit where the first landed, so don’t stand with your back to a wall and walk out of the area. If Poppy charges Poppy R Keeper’s Verdict, move sideways out of its path.

Rammus.watch: When Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active, his armor rises sharply and Briar takes reflected damage from basic attacks. Stop attacking and wait for it to end. Rammus E Frenzying Taunt is targeted and cannot be dodged within range, so keep your distance beforehand. If Rammus approaches quickly with Rammus Q Powerball, Rammus R Soaring Slam also covers a wider area. Back well away and leave the landing zone.
Rammus.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Rammus Q Powerball, Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl, and Rammus R Soaring Slam. If you are often caught by crowd control, including Rammus E Frenzying Taunt, consider tenacity.
Rammus.fight: Do not hit Rammus with the rapid basic attacks from Briar W Blood Frenzy while Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl is active. Once it ends, use Briar Q Head Rush to select and stun your target, then deal damage with Briar W Blood Frenzy. Use Briar W Snack Attack after the target has lost health, or immediately if you urgently need healing.
Rammus.laning: While clearing jungle camps, use Briar W Blood Frenzy and use Briar E Chilling Scream to heal. Position yourself in advance so a minion is between you and the path Rammus will take with Rammus Q Powerball. Gank when an ally has reliable crowd control or the enemy has pushed the lane, and do not activate Briar W Blood Frenzy before choosing your target.
Rammus.combo: After Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl ends, close in and stun him with Briar Q Head Rush, then activate Briar W Blood Frenzy and basic attack. Once his health drops, bite with Briar W Snack Attack. If the fight turns bad, use Briar E Chilling Scream to end the frenzy.
Rammus.escape: The window to engage is while Rammus R Soaring Slam is down. If Rammus E Frenzying Taunt is also down, close the gap with Briar Q Head Rush or Briar R Certain Death, then hold him in place with Briar E Chilling Scream.
Rammus.phase: Briar has strong early ganks, but a failed engage is risky, so choose only lanes with a clear opening. Later, engaging first can get you killed before you can heal; join after your allies engage.
Rammus.teamfight: Choose your target first so Briar W Blood Frenzy does not pull you into a frontline Rammus with Rammus W Defensive Ball Curl active. After your allies land their first crowd control, engage with Briar R Certain Death on a target they can attack with you. If the fight turns bad during the frenzy, use Briar E Chilling Scream to regain control.

RekSai.watch: When Rek'Sai goes underground with Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow, watch for the knockup and move toward open ground, away from walls and narrow paths. As she emerges, you can move with Briar Q Head Rush to dodge the knockup. If Rek'Sai recently damaged you, Rek'Sai R Void Rush may follow, so stay close to allies and do not use targeted abilities during her leap.
RekSai.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from the basic attacks of Rek'Sai Q Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker and from Rek'Sai R Void Rush. Resistances cannot reduce the true damage from Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel, and Rek'Sai R Void Rush deals damage based on maximum health, so do not rely on stacking health alone. If the fight becomes a sustained exchange of healing, buy Executioner's Calling between core items.
RekSai.fight: After dodging the knockup from Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow, lock onto your target with Briar Q Head Rush and activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. Lower her health with basic attacks, then recast Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack for damage and healing. If Rek'Sai tries to heal while burrowed, stay close and keep attacking. If the fight turns against you during the frenzy, use Briar E Chilling Scream to regain control.
RekSai.laning: Early on, avoid moving alone through areas without vision so Rek'Sai's ganks do not earn her a kill. If you see a Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel entrance near a lane or in your team's jungle, step on it to destroy it. Gank lanes where an ally has reliable crowd control or the enemy has pushed up. If there is no opening, do not activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack.
RekSai.combo: Stun Rek'Sai with Briar Q Head Rush, close in with Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack and land basic attacks, then recast Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack once health has decreased. If her escape path leads toward a wall, fully charge Briar E Chilling Scream to try for a wall stun. If health is at risk, do not delay recasting Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack for healing.
RekSai.escape: Dodging the knockup from Rek'Sai W Burrow / Un-burrow creates an opening to engage. If only Rek'Sai E Furious Bite / Tunnel is down, she can still escape with Rek'Sai R Void Rush. Once that is down too, close the gap with Briar Q Head Rush, Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, or Briar R Certain Death. After getting close, block her escape route with Briar E Chilling Scream.
RekSai.phase: Rek'Sai's early ganks are threatening, so avoid giving up kills and buy time. Later, Briar can fall before she heals if she engages first, so finish the fight after your allies start it.
RekSai.teamfight: After your allies land their first crowd control, aim Briar R Certain Death at a target they can attack with you. On landing, stun the target with Briar Q Head Rush, then keep dealing damage with basic attacks and a recast of Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. Avoid landing alone in the enemy backline. If the fight turns bad during the frenzy, use Briar E Chilling Scream to end it.

Rengar.watch: Rengar P Unseen Predator lets him leap from brush and build his resource, so avoid paths beside brush when he is out of sight. When his resource bar is full, empowered Rengar E Bola Strike roots and empowered Rengar W Battle Roar removes crowd control, so avoid fighting then. Do not travel alone at low health while Rengar R Thrill of the Hunt is a threat.
Rengar.build: Build armor first against Rengar's main damage. If he is sustaining through fights with Rengar W Battle Roar, fit Executioner's Calling between core items. If the root from Rengar E Bola Strike keeps you from basic attacking for too long, consider Mercurial Scimitar.
Rengar.fight: Trade after Rengar's resource bar is empty and Rengar W Battle Roar is down. Dodge Rengar E Bola Strike, then close in and select your target with Briar Q Head Rush before attacking with Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. Recast Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack after Rengar's health drops, or immediately for healing if your health is in danger.
Rengar.laning: Clear jungle camps with the area basic attacks from Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, and charge Briar E Chilling Scream to restore health. While Rengar is out of sight, avoid paths beside brush and use a Control Ward to secure vision in brush. Gank where an ally has reliable crowd control or the enemy has pushed the lane. If there is no opening, do not activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack.
Rengar.combo: Once Rengar W Battle Roar is down and you have dodged Rengar E Bola Strike, stun him with Briar Q Head Rush and activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. Lower his health with basic attacks, then recast Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack to bite. If needed, use Briar E Chilling Scream to hold him in place or end the frenzy.
Rengar.escape: After avoiding Rengar E Bola Strike, engage with Briar Q Head Rush or Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. If Rengar W Battle Roar is also down, you have less reason to worry about him removing crowd control, so hold him in place with Briar E Chilling Scream. Rengar has no ability to create distance on his own, making it hard for him to escape once you get close.
Rengar.phase: Briar has strong early ganks, but a failed engage can easily get her killed, so take only clear openings. Later, engaging first can get you killed before you can heal; finish the fight after your allies engage.
Rengar.teamfight: After answering Rengar's engage, use Briar Q Head Rush or Briar E Chilling Scream to hold him in place once Rengar W Battle Roar is down. Use Briar R Certain Death on a target your allies can attack immediately, and engage after they land their first crowd control. If the fight turns bad while chasing with Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, end the frenzy with Briar E Chilling Scream.

Sejuani.watch: Watch the windups of Sejuani Q Arctic Assault and Sejuani R Glacial Prison, then move sideways to dodge them. If the first hit of Sejuani W Winter's Wrath connects, move out of range before the second. If Sejuani E Permafrost stacks are building while you are close to an enemy melee champion near Sejuani, create distance immediately.
Sejuani.build: Build magic resistance first against Sejuani's main damage. Sejuani W Winter's Wrath deals physical damage, which magic resistance cannot reduce, and Sejuani P Fury of the North deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid stacking health alone.
Sejuani.fight: Right after Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is used, select your target with Briar Q Head Rush and activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. Lower the target's health with basic attacks, then recast Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack for damage and healing. If the fight turns bad, use Briar E Chilling Scream to end the frenzy and regain control.
Sejuani.laning: Early on, gank lanes where an ally has reliable crowd control or the enemy has pushed up. If there is no opening, do not activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. Clear jungle camps in a frenzy, and when health has decreased, charge Briar E Chilling Scream to heal.
Sejuani.combo: Once Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is down, leap in and stun her with Briar Q Head Rush, then activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. Basic attack and recast Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack after her health drops. Follow up with Briar E Chilling Scream when Sejuani has trouble escaping; if she is near a wall, fully charge it to try for a wall stun.
Sejuani.escape: Sejuani Q Arctic Assault is a mobility tool, so forcing her to use it creates an immediate window for Briar to engage. If Sejuani E Permafrost stuns you, create distance as soon as it ends to avoid the follow-up basic attack. Decide whether to re-engage based on whether Sejuani's crowd control is down.
Sejuani.phase: Sejuani has low kill and damage stats early, so use Briar's strong ganks to seek control and objectives. Later, Briar can fall before she heals if she engages first, so go in after your allies start the fight.
Sejuani.teamfight: After your allies land their first crowd control, target an enemy they can attack with you using Briar R Certain Death. Choose an angle that keeps Sejuani from blocking the hemolith in front. On landing, stun the target with Briar Q Head Rush and keep attacking. If the fight turns bad during the frenzy, use Briar E Chilling Scream to regain control.

Shaco.watch: Around bushes you have no vision of and objectives, watch for the fear from Shaco W Jack In The Box and check first with a Control Ward or Oracle Lens. If Shaco appears with Shaco Q Deceive, put your back to a wall or face your allies so he cannot get behind you. The clone from Shaco R Hallucinate explodes and leaves boxes when it dies, so retreat immediately if you kill it.
Shaco.build: Build magic resistance first against damage from Shaco W Jack In The Box, Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison, and Shaco R Hallucinate. Get health to avoid the low-health range where Shaco E Two-Shiv Poison deals more damage, and movement speed to leave areas with boxes.
Shaco.fight: Immediately after Shaco enters a fight with Shaco Q Deceive and reveals himself, focus him with your allies. Select and stun the target with Briar Q Head Rush, then activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. Recast Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack after his health drops, or immediately if you urgently need healing.
Shaco.laning: Early on, keep vision at your jungle entrances to watch for Shaco's ganks and invades. Check for Shaco W Jack In The Box around objectives without vision. If you cannot remove the boxes, start the objective only from a position where you have room to retreat even if feared. A failed Briar gank is dangerous, so gank where an ally has reliable crowd control or the enemy has pushed the lane.
Shaco.combo: When Shaco appears with Shaco Q Deceive, engage and stun him with Briar Q Head Rush, then activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. Lower his health with basic attacks, then recast Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack to bite him. If the fight turns bad, use Briar E Chilling Scream to end the frenzy and regain control.
Shaco.escape: Right after Shaco uses Shaco Q Deceive is your chance to close the gap. If he used it to enter the fight and revealed himself, engage with Briar Q Head Rush and, if needed, close the gap with Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack or Briar R Certain Death. Follow up with Briar E Chilling Scream to keep him in place.
Shaco.phase: Early on, Shaco looks for gains through ganks and invades, so avoid giving up kills while securing vision and objectives. His solo fighting strength falls off later, but Briar is also at risk if she engages first. Enter after your allies start the fight.
Shaco.teamfight: If Shaco enters with Shaco Q Deceive and reveals himself, focus him immediately with your allies. If he uses Shaco R Hallucinate, identify the real Shaco by how the health bars react, and move away from where the clone dies. Aim Briar R Certain Death at the real Shaco when your allies can immediately attack him with you. If the fight turns bad during frenzy, use Briar E Chilling Scream to regain control.

Shyvana.watch: Shyvana E Molten Burst slows and deals damage based on maximum health, so be careful about staying close to fight after it hits. Shyvana R Dragon's Descent is unstoppable during her entry, so do not try to stop her with a stun then. Wait until she lands, then catch her with Briar Q Head Rush or Briar E Chilling Scream. In dragon form, spread out from your allies so her area attacks do not hit you together.
Shyvana.build: Build magic resistance first for the magic damage from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis, Shyvana E Molten Burst, and Shyvana R Dragon's Descent. Get armor for her basic attacks too, and avoid stacking only health because she deals damage based on maximum health. If fights become a test of endurance against the healing from Shyvana W Inferno Aegis, buy Executioner's Calling between core items.
Shyvana.fight: Pressure Shyvana when her Fury bar is empty or after her dragon form ends. Select her with Briar Q Head Rush, then activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack and attack. Recast Briar W Snack Attack after her health drops to increase damage and healing, or use it immediately for healing if Briar's health is in danger.
Shyvana.laning: Early on, pressure jungle camps and objectives before Shyvana builds stacks. Clear camps with Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack and heal with Briar E Chilling Scream. Gank lanes where an ally has crowd control or the enemy has pushed up.
Shyvana.combo: On a gank, stun Shyvana with Briar Q Head Rush, activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, then basic attack. Recast Briar W Snack Attack once her health drops. If she enters with Shyvana R Dragon's Descent, wait for her to land before catching her with Briar Q Head Rush. Use Briar E Chilling Scream to end the frenzy, or charge it to seek a stun if her escape path leads toward a wall.
Shyvana.escape: Engage when Shyvana R Dragon's Descent is down and her Fury bar is empty. Shyvana has no ability to create distance on her own, so close in with Briar Q Head Rush, chase with Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, and catch her with Briar E Chilling Scream. If the fight turns bad after you engage, use Briar E Chilling Scream to end the frenzy and regain control.
Shyvana.phase: Early on, pressure Shyvana before she has stacks and take camps and objectives first. She grows stronger as she gains stacks, and Briar is at risk if she engages first late in the game. Enter after your allies start the fight and finish it.
Shyvana.teamfight: When Shyvana is in dragon form, spread out so the path of Shyvana R Dragon's Descent and her area attacks do not hit several allies. After an ally lands the first crowd control, use Briar R Certain Death on a target your allies can attack with you. After landing, stun with Briar Q Head Rush and finish with basic attacks and a recast of Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. If it becomes dangerous, use Briar E Chilling Scream to end the frenzy.

Skarner.fight: Right after Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down, select and stun him with Briar Q Head Rush, then stay on him with Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack and follow up with empowered basic attacks. Keep the close-range fight short so you do not keep taking empowered basic attacks from Skarner Q Shattered Earth / Upheaval. If the fight turns bad, use Briar E Chilling Scream to end the frenzy and regain control.
Skarner.laning: Early on, seek jungle control and objectives to delay Skarner's tank items. Clear camps with Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, and use Briar E Chilling Scream to heal at each camp. Gank where an ally has reliable crowd control or the enemy has pushed the lane. If there is no opening, do not activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack.
Skarner.combo: Once Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down, stun him first with Briar Q Head Rush, activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, then basic attack. After his health drops, recast Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack for damage and healing. If Skarner retreats toward a wall, fully charge Briar E Chilling Scream to seek a wall stun.
Skarner.escape: Right after you force Skarner E Ixtal's Impact, there is an opening to close the gap with Briar Q Head Rush, Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, or Briar R Certain Death. Use Briar E Chilling Scream to block his escape route. If Skarner R Impale is still available, account for the fact that you cannot escape with a movement ability after he suppresses you.
Skarner.phase: Early on, focus on securing jungle control and objectives before Skarner gets tank items. Later, Briar may fall before she can heal if she engages first, so follow a fight your allies have started.
Skarner.teamfight: After an ally lands the first crowd control, aim Briar R Certain Death at a target your allies can attack with you. Skarner can block the bloodstone from the front, so find an angle that reaches your intended target. Also watch the short range of Skarner R Impale and the direction he could drag you. If the fight turns bad during frenzy, use Briar E Chilling Scream to regain control and retreat.
Skarner.build: Decide first whether to include Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar in your build to counter the suppression from Skarner R Impale. Prioritize magic resistance to counter Skarner P Threads of Vibration, W Seismic Bastion, and R Impale. Skarner P Threads of Vibration and Q Shattered Earth / Upheaval deal damage based on your maximum health, so avoid choices that add a lot of health alone, and consider movement speed to get out of telegraphed areas.

Taliyah.watch: Do not dash across the rocky field with Briar Q Head Rush or Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. Taliyah Q Threaded Volley cannot change direction during its cast, so sidestep it.
Taliyah.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Taliyah Q Threaded Volley and Taliyah E Unraveled Earth. The source material gives no specific item to buy first, so the purchase order cannot be specified.
Taliyah.fight: While Taliyah E Unraveled Earth is on the ground, do not dash. Walk in or go around the rocky field. When you have an opening to reach her, select her with Briar Q Head Rush, then activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. Recast it after her health drops for damage and healing.
Taliyah.laning: For early jungle clears, use Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack to clear camps and charge Briar E Chilling Scream to heal. Gank where an ally has reliable crowd control or Taliyah has pushed the lane. If Taliyah disappears from the jungle, she may intervene in another lane, so watch for this and be ready to back off in advance.
Taliyah.combo: After avoiding Taliyah E Unraveled Earth, close in and stun her with Briar Q Head Rush, activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, then basic attack. Recast Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack when her health drops. If the fight turns bad, use Briar E Chilling Scream to end the frenzy and regain control.
Taliyah.escape: After Taliyah E Unraveled Earth is down, you have a chance to close the gap with Briar Q Head Rush or Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. If Taliyah R Weaver's Wall is also still on cooldown, she has fewer ways to escape, so look to engage then. Once you reach her, use Briar E Chilling Scream to prevent her escape.
Taliyah.phase: Briar has strong early ganks, but a failed engage can easily lead to death, so take only clear openings. Briar peaks in the mid game when she has both attack damage and health; actively look for chances to reach Taliyah. Late in the game, she can fall before healing if she engages first, so enter after your allies start the fight.
Taliyah.teamfight: After an ally lands the first crowd control, aim Briar R Certain Death at Taliyah when your allies can attack her with you. Find an angle that avoids hitting the front line first, then stun Taliyah with Briar Q Head Rush after landing and keep attacking.
