If the fight turns bad after you engage, use Briar E Chilling Scream to end the frenzy.

Udyr.watch: Right after Udyr activates E Blazing Stampede, his stun is ready, so do not engage first. Counterattack after taking the stun. Wait for the empowered E Blazing Stampede to end before trying to immobilize him with Briar Q Head Rush or Briar E Chilling Scream. Udyr Q Wilding Claw and Udyr R Wingborne Storm deal damage based on maximum health, so do not rely on health alone.
Udyr.build: Build armor first against Udyr's main damage. Armor does not block the magic damage from Udyr R Wingborne Storm, and Udyr Q Wilding Claw deals both physical and magic damage. If healing from Udyr W Iron Mantle prolongs fights, fit Executioner's Calling between core items. If his basic attacks and attack speed are a problem, consider an option that reduces attack speed.
Udyr.fight: Press the attack once the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle is gone and he has just used Udyr E Blazing Stampede. Pick your target and close in with Briar Q Head Rush, then activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack and lower his health with basic attacks. Recast Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack after lowering his health, or immediately for healing if Briar is in danger.
Udyr.laning: Track Udyr's path with vision at jungle entrances and key routes. While he is out of sight, do not overextend into a lane where he can gank you. Briar can clear camps with area basic attacks from Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, and when health has decreased, charge Briar E Chilling Scream to heal. Gank lanes where an ally has reliable crowd control or the enemy has pushed up.
Udyr.combo: Once you have taken the stun from Udyr E Blazing Stampede and its empowered effect has ended, close in and stun him with Briar Q Head Rush, then activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. Lower his health with basic attacks, recast Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack to bite, and use Briar E Chilling Scream to end the frenzy. If Udyr has his back to a wall, fully charge Briar E Chilling Scream to try for a wall stun.
Udyr.escape: Right after forcing Udyr to use E Blazing Stampede, you have an opening to close the gap with Briar Q Head Rush or Briar R Certain Death. Immobilizing effects do not work during the empowered E Blazing Stampede, so wait until it ends before trying to hold him with Briar E Chilling Scream. If the engage turns bad, use Briar E Chilling Scream to end the frenzy and regain control.
Udyr.phase: Briar has strong early ganks, but a failed engage can easily get her killed, so take only clear openings. Later, engaging first can get her killed before she can heal; enter after your allies start the fight.
Udyr.teamfight: Do not force attacks onto Udyr when he has defensive items and the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle. Target a vulnerable enemy behind him with your allies. Enter with Briar R Certain Death after an ally lands the first crowd control, but aim so Udyr cannot intercept it: the first champion the bloodstone hits becomes Briar's target. After landing, lock down the target with Briar Q Head Rush. If the fight turns bad during the frenzy, use Briar E Chilling Scream to regain control.

Vi.watch: Vi Q Vault Breaker deals more damage when charged, so back away or sidestep as soon as Vi starts charging it. Repeated hits on the same target with Vi W Denting Blows reduce armor and increase Vi's attack speed, so do not stay in an extended fight. Vi R Cease and Desist cannot be stopped while she is charging in; use Briar E Chilling Scream after the knockup ends.
Vi.build: Buy armor first against Vi's primarily physical damage. Vi W Denting Blows deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid stacking health alone. Basic attacks and attack speed are also key to her damage, so reducing her attack speed helps.
Vi.fight: Immediately after dodging Vi Q Vault Breaker or forcing Vi to use it, close in with Briar Q Head Rush. Activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack once you have picked a target, then recast it after lowering the target's health for damage and healing. Do not take repeated hits from Vi W Denting Blows for long. If the fight becomes dangerous, use Briar E Chilling Scream to end the frenzy.
Vi.laning: Clear jungle camps with Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, and use Briar E Chilling Scream to heal at each camp. Gank lanes where an ally has reliable crowd control or the enemy has pushed up. If Vi engages after activating a shield with an ability, fight after the shield has been stripped away.
Vi.combo: Once Vi Q Vault Breaker is down, stun your target with Briar Q Head Rush, then activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. Lower the target's health with basic attacks, then recast Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack to bite and heal. If Vi R Cease and Desist hits you, wait until the knockup ends, then use Briar E Chilling Scream to end the frenzy or stop Vi from escaping.
Vi.escape: Right after forcing Vi to use Q Vault Breaker is Briar's chance to close the gap. Close in with Briar Q Head Rush and use Briar E Chilling Scream to block her escape. Do not waste Briar E Chilling Scream while Vi R Cease and Desist is charging toward you; wait until she lands and the knockup ends.
Vi.phase: Early on, even though Briar's ganks are strong, a failed engage can be fatal, so choose windows when Vi Q Vault Breaker is down and clear gank openings. Later, engaging first can get Briar killed before she can heal, so finish fights after your allies start them.
Vi.teamfight: Move together so the backline damage dealer Vi R Cease and Desist may target stays within range of allied protective abilities. After an ally lands the first crowd control, hit a target your allies can attack with Briar R Certain Death, then stun that target with Briar Q Head Rush after landing. If the engage turns bad, use Briar E Chilling Scream to end the frenzy and regain control.

Warwick.build: Build magic resistance first against Warwick P Eternal Hunger, Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast, and Warwick R Infinite Duress. Get armor for his basic attack damage as well. If both sides keep healing through a long fight, fit Executioner's Calling between core items.
Warwick.fight: Reengage after the fear from Warwick E Primal Howl triggers and the ability ends. Pick your target with Briar Q Head Rush and attack with Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, but do not dive deep and disregard his healing just because Warwick is low on health.
Warwick.laning: Early on, exploit Warwick's slow jungle clear to gain an advantage through jungle invades and lane priority. Gank lanes where an ally has reliable crowd control or the enemy has pushed up. If health falls below half, keep Warwick W Blood Hunt in mind and prioritize recalling over farming.
Warwick.combo: After the fear from Warwick E Primal Howl triggers, close in and stun him with Briar Q Head Rush, then activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack and basic attack. Recast Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack once his health drops. If the fight turns bad, use Briar E Chilling Scream to end the frenzy.
Warwick.escape: Do not engage just because Warwick Q Jaws of the Beast is down. Look for an opening before Warwick R Infinite Duress comes back as well. After the fear from Warwick E Primal Howl triggers, close the gap with Briar Q Head Rush or Briar R Certain Death, then use Briar E Chilling Scream to block his escape.
Warwick.phase: Early on, avoid giving Warwick kills while getting ahead through jungle invades and lane priority. Later, let your allies start the fight, then enter to finish it.
Warwick.teamfight: After an ally lands the first crowd control, aim Briar R Certain Death at a target your allies can attack with you. If Warwick R Infinite Duress suppresses an ally, prioritize saving that ally and focus your counterattack during the period when Warwick is locked in place just after using his ultimate. If the fight turns bad during Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, use Briar E Chilling Scream to end the frenzy.

Viego.watch: The longer Viego charges W Spectral Maw, the longer its stun lasts. Sidestep when you see him charging it, and interrupt him with Briar Q Head Rush if you can reach him. When Viego E Harrowed Path covers terrain, watch for Viego concealed within it and take another route. When your health is low, you are an easy target for Viego R Heartbreaker, so stay with your team.
Viego.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Viego Q Blade of The Ruined King and Viego R Heartbreaker. If healing from Viego P Sovereign's Domination and Viego Q Blade of The Ruined King prolongs duels, fit Executioner's Calling between core items. Viego Q Blade of The Ruined King adds damage based on current health, so avoid stacking health alone.
Viego.fight: After sidestepping the charge of Viego W Spectral Maw or interrupting it with Briar Q Head Rush, lock onto your target and attack with Briar W Blood Frenzy. Once Viego's health drops, recast Briar W Snack Attack for damage based on missing health and healing. If the fight turns against you, use Briar E Chilling Scream to end the frenzy and retreat.
Viego.laning: Clear jungle camps with the area basic attacks from Briar W Blood Frenzy, and heal with Briar E Chilling Scream at each camp. Gank lanes where an ally has reliable crowd control or the enemy has pushed up. Check routes covered by the black mist from Viego E Harrowed Path with a Control Ward or take another route, and do not push a lane in that direction.
Viego.combo: When closing in on Viego, stun him with Briar Q Head Rush, activate Briar W Blood Frenzy, and basic attack. Recast Briar W Snack Attack after lowering Viego's health. If his escape route runs toward a wall, fully charge Briar E Chilling Scream to follow up with a wall stun.
Viego.escape: Do not engage immediately just because Viego W Spectral Maw is down. Before Viego R Heartbreaker comes back, close the gap with Briar Q Head Rush or Briar R Certain Death once Viego W Spectral Maw is also down or you have interrupted its charge. Then use Briar E Chilling Scream to stop his escape.
Viego.phase: Briar has strong early ganks, but a failed engage can easily get her killed, so take only clear openings. In the late game, engaging first can get her killed before she can heal; enter fights after your allies start them.
Viego.teamfight: After an ally lands the first crowd control, target Viego with Briar R Certain Death when your allies can attack him with you. If an ally falls in front of Viego, do not keep fighting there. Use Briar's stun or Briar E Chilling Scream to keep Viego from reaching the wraith. If Viego possesses someone, keep your distance and hold out until he returns to his original body, then counterattack.

XinZhao.watch: Dodge the later thrust of Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning sideways to prevent the Challenged status and deny an opening for the follow-up long-distance dash. If two empowered attacks from Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike hit you, create distance before the third attack knocks you up. While Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard is active, do not try to deal damage from outside his spear range.
XinZhao.build: Build armor first against Xin Zhao's main damage. If the fight drags on as you both heal, buy Executioner's Calling between core items to reduce healing from Xin Zhao P Determination.
XinZhao.fight: Dodge the thrust of Xin Zhao W Wind Becomes Lightning sideways, then close the gap right after he uses Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge. Select your target with Briar Q Head Rush, then attack with Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. Recast W once the target has lost health to increase its damage and healing. When Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard is active, do not press the attack recklessly; counterattack after its duration ends.
XinZhao.laning: Clear camps with Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, and charge Briar E Chilling Scream to heal when health has been lost. Gank lanes where an ally has guaranteed crowd control or the enemy has pushed up. If there is no clear opening, do not engage: Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack will force you to chase.
XinZhao.combo: Once Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge is down, close in and stun him with Briar Q Head Rush, then activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack and use basic attacks. Recast W after he has lost health, and use Briar E Chilling Scream along his escape path. If his back is to a wall, fully charge E to stun him against it.
XinZhao.escape: Right after you draw out Xin Zhao E Audacious Charge, look to engage with Briar Q Head Rush or Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. If you dodge the third hit of Xin Zhao Q Three Talon Strike, you can keep fighting without being knocked up. If the fight turns bad after you engage, use Briar E Chilling Scream to end the frenzy and regain control.
XinZhao.phase: Briar has strong early ganks, but a failed engage is risky, so take only clear openings. Later, let an ally start the fight before you enter, and look for the moment Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard ends.
XinZhao.teamfight: Keep some space between yourself and your allies so the knockback from Xin Zhao R Crescent Guard does not split your formation. After an ally lands the first crowd control, use Briar R Certain Death on a target your team can attack together. Avoid engaging alone into the enemy backline. If the fight turns bad during the frenzy, use Briar E Chilling Scream to stop chasing.

Zac.watch: Zac E Elastic Slingshot has a visible charge and knocks you up if it lands. If you see him charging it behind a wall, interrupt him with the stun from Briar Q Head Rush or move away from his landing spot. In close fights, watch for the maximum-health damage from Zac W Unstable Matter, and step on the blobs from Zac P Cell Division to deny his healing.
Zac.build: If Zac sustains through fights with healing, buy Executioner's Calling between core items. Prioritize magic resistance over armor against damage from Zac Q Stretching Strikes, Zac W Unstable Matter, and Zac E Elastic Slingshot. Since Zac W Unstable Matter deals damage based on maximum health, avoid building only a large health pool.
Zac.fight: Interrupt the charge of Zac E Elastic Slingshot with Briar Q Head Rush, or close the gap right after he uses E. Trade damage while stepping on the blobs from Zac P Cell Division to deny his healing. Select your target before activating Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, and recast it after Zac has lost health.
Zac.laning: Clear camps with Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack and use Briar E Chilling Scream to heal. Gank lanes where an ally has guaranteed crowd control or the enemy has pushed up. If Zac is nearby, lock onto your target with Briar Q Head Rush before activating Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack.
Zac.combo: Interrupt the charge of Zac E Elastic Slingshot with Briar Q Head Rush, or use Q to close in and stun him right after he uses E. Then activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, lower his health with basic attacks, and recast W. Use Briar E Chilling Scream when you need to end the frenzy or keep Zac in place.
Zac.escape: Right after you draw out Zac E Elastic Slingshot, Briar has an opening to engage. Close the gap with Briar Q Head Rush or Briar R Certain Death, then use Briar E Chilling Scream to stop Zac from escaping.
Zac.phase: The available information does not establish which of Zac and Briar is stronger early. Later, let an ally start the fight, then enter to finish it.
Zac.teamfight: When you see Zac charging Zac E Elastic Slingshot, look for a chance to interrupt it with the stun from Briar Q Head Rush. After you withstand his engage, create distance from Zac to reduce the area damage from Zac W Unstable Matter. Once an ally lands the first crowd control, use Briar R Certain Death on a target your team can attack together. If your engage becomes dangerous, use Briar E Chilling Scream to end the frenzy.

Belveth.watch: Bel'Veth W Above and Below knocks up and slows, so sidestep it as she closes in. While Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom is active, she takes much less damage, so do not rush the recast of Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. Bel'Veth cannot immediately dash again in a direction she just used for Bel'Veth Q Void Surge, so track that direction as you move.
Belveth.build: Build armor first because Bel'Veth Q Void Surge and Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom deal physical damage. You also need health because resistances cannot stop the true damage from Bel'Veth R Endless Banquet. If her healing prolongs fights, buy Executioner's Calling between core items.
Belveth.fight: Dodge Bel'Veth W Above and Below sideways, then close in and stun her with Briar Q Head Rush. Once you have locked onto her, activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. Save your high-damage abilities while Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom is active, and look for a chance to interrupt it with the stun from Briar Q Head Rush. Recast Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack after Bel'Veth has lost health, but use it immediately for healing if Briar's health is in danger.
Belveth.laning: Briar has no base health regeneration, so use Briar E Chilling Scream to heal at each camp. Look for ganks where an ally has guaranteed crowd control or the enemy has pushed up.
Belveth.combo: Stun Bel'Veth first with Briar Q Head Rush, activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, and follow with basic attacks. Once Bel'Veth has lost health, recast W to bite her, and use Briar E Chilling Scream when you disengage. If her back is to a wall, fully charge E to attempt a wall stun.
Belveth.escape: Right after you dodge Bel'Veth W Above and Below is an opening to engage. Each direction of Bel'Veth Q Void Surge has its own cooldown, so note the direction she dashed and close the gap with the stun from Briar Q Head Rush and Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack before her next dash. If the fight turns bad after you engage, use Briar E Chilling Scream to end the frenzy and regain control.
Belveth.teamfight: After an ally lands the first crowd control, target Bel'Veth with Briar R Certain Death when your team can attack her together. Save your high-damage abilities during Bel'Veth E Royal Maelstrom, and look for a chance to interrupt it with the stun from Briar Q Head Rush. If an ally falls and leaves Void Coral, back away before Bel'Veth picks it up, and delay the teamfight while she is transformed.
Belveth.phase: Bel’Veth is weak early before she has stacks, so look for chances for Briar to pressure her in the jungle. Bel’Veth grows stronger as she gains stacks, so don’t engage first as Briar in the late game; finish the fight after your allies start it.

Nocturne.watch: When Nocturne R Paranoia darkens your screen, move toward your allies immediately instead of staying isolated. The fear from Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror triggers only if its tether holds, so keep Briar Q Head Rush available to create distance as soon as it attaches. Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness blocks one ability and increases his attack speed if it does, so do not immediately use the stun from Briar Q Head Rush while his shield is active.
Nocturne.build: Build armor first because the main damage from Nocturne P Umbra Blades, Nocturne Q Duskbringer, and Nocturne R Paranoia is physical. If healing from Nocturne P Umbra Blades prolongs fights, buy Executioner's Calling between core items.
Nocturne.fight: While Nocturne R Paranoia is down, select your target with Briar Q Head Rush, then activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. Lower their health with basic attacks, then recast W for damage and healing based on missing health. If Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is active, break the shield first so it does not absorb the stun from Briar Q Head Rush.
Nocturne.laning: Clear jungle camps with the area basic attacks from Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, and charge Briar E Chilling Scream to heal when your health drops. Gank lanes where an ally has guaranteed crowd control or the enemy has pushed up. Maintain vision at the river and jungle entrances. If Nocturne Q Duskbringer hits you, do not flee in a straight line along its trail; angle toward an ally or turret.
Nocturne.combo: If Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is down, stun him with Briar Q Head Rush, activate Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, and use basic attacks. Recast W after he has lost health. If Nocturne W Shroud of Darkness is active, break the shield first with Briar E Chilling Scream, then look for the stun from Briar Q Head Rush.
Nocturne.escape: While Nocturne R Paranoia, his mobility ability, is down, Briar has an opening to close the gap. If Nocturne E Unspeakable Horror is down, close in with Briar Q Head Rush and keep attacking with Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack. If E is still available, save a way to move out of tether range.
Nocturne.phase: Later, let an ally start the fight before you enter to finish it.
Nocturne.teamfight: When Nocturne R Paranoia darkens your screen, group with your allies so you are not caught alone. After an ally lands the first crowd control, use Briar R Certain Death on an enemy your team can attack together. If the fight turns bad during Briar W Blood Frenzy / Snack Attack, use Briar E Chilling Scream to end the frenzy and regain control.
